question.worked_solution:
If $F(x)$ is defined on $x\in [0,10),$ the odd extension of $F$ is the function $f$ such that

$$
f(x)=\{\begin{aligned}F(x), & x\in [0,10), \\ -F(-x), & x\in (-10,0).\end{aligned}
$$

In our case, for $x\in (-10,0),$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}f(x) & =-F(-x) \\  & =-((-x)^{2}-2(-x)) \\  & =-({x}^{2}+2x) \\  & =-{x}^{2}-2x.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}f(-6) & =-(-6)^{2}-2(-6)=-24.\end{aligned}
$$
